name: Are there any limitations to using AI for real estate market analysis?

mainEntity.name: Are there any limitations to using AI for real estate market analysis?

acceptedAnswer.text: While powerful, AI for real estate market analysis does have limitations. It relies on historical data and may not fully capture sudden, unprecedented market shifts or unique, non-quantifiable aspects of a property, such as emotional appeal or specific unrecorded local developments. Additionally, the quality of the AI's output is dependent on the quality and completeness of the input data. Kelby Contreras always reviews AI insights with a critical eye, combining them with human expertise to ensure the most accurate and practical advice.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI market analysis has limitations, including reliance on historical data and difficulty capturing sudden shifts or unique property aspects; human expertise remains crucial for comprehensive advice.
